subject: a small house with a layered cloud roof
pose: house low right, roof opening left
art_direction: 无字小屋的屋顶变成厚纸云层，低处暖窗轻亮，四周浅灰很柔和。
visible_description: 无字小屋的屋顶变成厚纸云层，低处暖窗轻亮，四周浅灰很柔和。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Build a small plain house whose roof unfolds into thick pale-blue paper cloud layers. Position it low on the right, with the cloud roof opening gently left and one warm unmarked window below. Show paper edges, simple wall texture and soft grounded shadows. A quiet warm-gray field surrounds the miniature, creating sheltered whimsy without a village, lettering or dramatic sky. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
